caption: Uses the file's real first row as column names.

code:
# Without inferSchema: every column is a string
df_strings = spark.read.csv(path, header=True)

# With inferSchema: Spark reads the file TWICE
df_typed = spark.read.csv(path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
df_typed.printSchema()
caption: One pass to guess types, one pass to load — a real cost on large files.

subtitle: A different file format, the same read API.
